description: social.md §5 opinion validity (O1–O5, axes, the deleted-subject rule) and §6.2 staged karma: K1 = pairsum(None, S), seedUp, E, KP = pairsum(Some(K1), E), K = pairsum(Some(KP), E) with the per-pair cap. input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: the karma projection fields listed (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section). Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: self-vote-ignored
vectors.note: O3: alice's opinion on her own post and mona's strongUp on her own post are ignored entirely (not even counted as unweighted); only mona's upvote of alice counts: K1 = KP = K = 1 for alice, whose single seed upvote does not establish her (seedUp 1 < 2)

vectors.name: strongUp-counts-1-in-K1
vectors.note: a strongUp counts as +1 (its sign) in K1 and with power strong(basis) in KP and K: gus (granted, K1 10) strongUps 5 of noah's posts (K1 5, KP 10); noah (granted, K1 5, KP 10) strongUps zed's post: K1[zed] = 1, KP[zed] = strong(5) = 1, K[zed] = strong(10) = 2

vectors.name: establishment-one-vs-two-seeds
vectors.note: open mode, establish 1, establishSeeds 2: nina has one seed upvote (K1 1, seedUp 1) and is not established; noah has two (K1 2, seedUp 2) and is. Both upvote zoe: only noah's vote has weight (KP[zoe] = power(K1[noah]=2, up) = 1); nina's still counts (O1–O5) and shows as not yet counted

vectors.name: seedUp-counts-distinct-seeds-with-positive-net
vectors.note: seedUp counts distinct seeds whose net sign sum on the user is positive: una gets two upvotes from mona (K1 2, seedUp 1); val gets +1 and −1 from mona (net 0) and +1 from mike (K1 1, seedUp 1); wes gets a strongUp from mona and an up from mike (K1 2, seedUp 2) and is the only one established

vectors.name: sybil-ring-without-seed-edge
vectors.note: three members strongUp each other's posts and rhea's; no seed votes for any of them, so K1, seedUp, KP and K are 0 for the ring and its votes have no weight anywhere; rhea is established by two seed upvotes and her K is 2 from those alone. The ring's opinions still count (O1–O5)

vectors.name: sybil-ring-with-one-seed-edge
vectors.note: as sybil-ring-without-seed-edge, plus one upvote from mona on syba's post: K1[syba] = 1 and seedUp[syba] = 1 < establishSeeds, so syba is still not established and the ring's votes still carry no weight

vectors.name: pairCap-boundary-25-26
vectors.note: pairCap 25 (default): mona upvotes 25 posts of pat and 26 of quin; each (voter, recipient) net sum is clamped to ±25 in K1 and to ±25 × strong(max(basis, 0)) = ±25 in KP and K (mona's basis is 0), so both get 25

vectors.name: pairCap-scaled-by-strong-in-KP-and-K
vectors.note: pairCap 2: gus (granted) gets two upvotes from each of five authorities (K1 10). He upvotes 5 posts of rob and strongDowns 3 of sal: K1 clamps each pair to ±2; KP and K clamp to ±pairCap × strong(max(basis, 0)) = ±2 × strong(10) = ±4, so rob gets 4 and sal −4 although the unclamped sums are 5 and −6

vectors.name: deleted-subject-one-vs-two-voters
vectors.note: subjects in `absent` (confirmed deleted): dora's post has one seed voter and earns nothing; dan's post and cam's comment have two distinct seed voters and earn 2 each (and establish both); wes's wikiRevision earns nothing (votes on wikiRevisions never earn karma). All seven opinions count (O2 holds through `absent`); the 2-voter rule only limits their karma

vectors.name: deleted-subject-threshold-per-stage
vectors.note: the 2-voter threshold uses each stage's eligible set (social.md §20.1 item 14): eve's deleted post has votes from mona (a seed) and noah (established). In K1 only one voter is in S, so neither vote is included; in KP and K both are in E, so KP[eve] = K[eve] = 2

vectors.name: deleted-subject-self-and-spam
vectors.note: O3 and O5 apply to the uri of a deleted subject: olly's own vote on his deleted post is ignored, which leaves one voter (no karma); sam's deleted post is resolved spam by a forum-scope #hide{spam} (a negative assertion, effective without the subject), so its two seed votes do not count

vectors.name: nullify
vectors.note: the owner nullifies gil (a granted seed): gil ∈ N, so gil leaves S, his opinions do not count (O4) and he cannot be established although two seeds upvote him (K1 2, seedUp 2). alice keeps only mona's vote (K1 1, seedUp 1, not established)

vectors.name: nullified-moderator-is-not-a-seed
vectors.note: the owner (rank 3) nullifies mike (a moderator, rank 1): mike stays an authority but leaves S and E, and his opinions do not count (O4), so alice has one seed upvote and is not established

vectors.name: restrict-vote
vectors.note: gil (a granted seed) is restricted from `vote`: his opinion still counts (O1–O5) but its karma and agreement axes are ignored, so alice has one effective seed upvote (K1 1, seedUp 1, not established) and agreement 0. A restriction is not a nullification: gil stays in S and E

vectors.name: seed-with-negative-K1-stays-in-E
vectors.note: P6: gil is a granted seed downvoted by two seeds (K1 −2, KP −2, K −2) and stays in E; his upvote of alice has power(max(−2, 0), up) = 1 in every stage

vectors.name: banned-voter
vectors.note: bea is banned: her opinion does not count (O4), and although two seeds upvote her (K1 2, seedUp 2) she is excluded from E (B ∪ N)

vectors.name: approval-mode-E-is-S
vectors.note: approval mode: E = S. bob is an applicant (membership, no grant), so bob ∉ P and two seed upvotes (K1 2, seedUp 2) do not establish him; his opinion counts (O4 excludes only B ∪ N) but has no weight. dora is a banned member: a participant (approval mode counts banned members) but in B, so not established either. carl is granted without a membership: a seed, so his upvote of alice counts

vectors.name: leaving-the-forum
vectors.note: open mode, after gil and noah deleted their membership records: gil was granted, so he stays a seed and his vote keeps counting; noah would be established (K1 2, seedUp 2) but is no longer a participant, so he leaves E and his vote stops carrying weight

vectors.name: establish-3-seeds-1
vectors.note: establish 3, establishSeeds 1: ann has three upvotes from one seed (K1 3, seedUp 1) and is established; ben has one from each of two seeds (K1 2, seedUp 2) and is not

vectors.name: establish-0-seeds-1
vectors.note: establish 0, establishSeeds 1: cora gets +1 from mona and −1 from mike (K1 0, seedUp 1: mona's net is positive) and is established; dee has no seed upvote (seedUp 0) and is not

vectors.name: wiki-and-sequence-votes-earn-no-karma
vectors.note: votes on a wikiRevision and a sequence count and give those items a score, but V (§6.2) holds only opinions on posts and comments, so they earn no karma and establish nobody

vectors.name: opinions-that-never-count
vectors.note: mike's second opinion has a wrong h16 in its rkey (invalid: G5) and fails O1. mona's opinions on the spam post (O5), on an untitled post (invalid: PO3), on a post that is neither in records nor in absent, and on a comment that CO5 excludes (its root post is invalid: G5, because its forum field names another forum) fail O5 or O2. The opinion on a hidden (not spam) post counts. mike's opinion with an unknown karma value counts with no karma axis (OP3); its agreement axis is kept. alice: K1 2, seedUp 1
